ida.summary: Government agency under the Ministry of Higher Education, Science and Innovation. Frontend of the national science and innovation ecosystem (ilmiy.uz): public portals, personal cabinets and admin panels for researchers, universities and state bodies.
bullets: Build and maintain the frontends of 15+ production platforms with React, Next.js and TypeScript, from project setup and architecture to release and support.

Turn Figma designs into responsive, accessible, multilingual interfaces; built shared component libraries on shadcn/ui, Radix UI, Ant Design and Tailwind CSS with design tokens, so new pages are assembled from ready blocks.

Design the data layer on TanStack Query, Redux Toolkit, Zustand and Axios: typed API clients from Swagger/OpenAPI, JWT refresh interceptors, caching and invalidation, pagination, optimistic updates, unified error handling.
Build complex forms with React Hook Form and Zod/Yup (multi-step flows, dynamic fields, draft persistence, unsaved-changes guards) and analytics dashboards with Recharts and Ant Design Charts.
Deliver SSR and SEO: Next.js App Router and Vite SSR on Express, metadata and Open Graph, sitemaps, Google Analytics, code splitting and lazy loading for a fast first load.

Own deployment: Docker and Docker Compose, nginx reverse proxy, PM2, CI/CD in GitHub Actions (self-hosted runners inside a closed network) and GitLab CI, separate dev, staging and production environments on Ubuntu servers.

Introduced an AI-assisted workflow: Claude Code with project rules, skills and MCP integrations for Figma and Linear across triage, planning, implementation and review; built the UI for AI features such as AI-generated text detection.

softwhere.summary: Software company: web and mobile apps built from scratch, plus new features for products in development.
bullets: Developed web apps with React and cross-platform mobile apps with React Native and Expo, from an empty repository to a production release.
Delivered CRUD features end to end against the backend API using React Query, Redux Toolkit and MobX; added real-time updates over WebSocket.
Worked with the backend team to stabilise the API contract, which made frontend integration faster and more predictable.
Fixed critical design, functionality and performance bugs and tested every release, shortening the path to production.

empire.summary: E-commerce products: online store applications for web, iOS and Android.
bullets: Developed an online store application for iOS and Android with React Native and Expo: catalogue, search, cart and checkout flows.
Designed the project structure and set up ESLint rules to keep the codebase clean and maintainable.
Built reusable UI components and state management with React, Redux Toolkit and MobX.
Proposed new features, took part in planning and technical decisions, and resolved bugs to keep shopping smooth for users.
